prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Heavy survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the exact approved single-facing shipped seed and locks this camera/facing. Image 2 is the four-view identity authority for costume/face details only; do not substitute any other facing from it. Preserve the same broad, stocky adult man with thick dark-brown hair and beard, a mustard-yellow ragged work coat/hood over charcoal sleeves and trousers, heavy brown boots/gloves, leather belt pouches and harness, and the brass cartridge bandolier crossing from physical LEFT shoulder to RIGHT waist. ONE dark iron six-barrel rotary gun has a brass ammunition belt. Physical RIGHT hand stays on its rear/top trigger grip; LEFT hand supports the forward cradle. Keep the gun rigid and both grips anatomically attached. No helmet, mask, second gun, weapon swap or extra belt. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet color planes and selective practical contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive tiny scratches, decorative filigree or noise. Maintain two arms, two legs and one intact body/weapon in every pose.
Every pose faces EAST, screen RIGHT, in the exact approved side/three-quarter angle. Nose and both boots point screen RIGHT. Physical RIGHT is the near-side rear trigger arm; LEFT is the forward support arm. Do not exchange grips, turn the chest to face the viewer, or mirror the other facing.
Draw EXACTLY 4 full-body poses as one coherent idle sheet, arranged in one horizontal row of 4 complete poses on a wide transparent canvas. No additional figure. Action: A quiet planted breathing cycle: 1 upright ready pose matching the seed, 2 slight inhale through shoulders, 3 gentle weight settlement, 4 return toward pose 1. Boots stay planted and both hands retain the original lowered weapon grips. Only subtle cloth movement; no walk or shot.
Every pose is one complete independent drawn body at ONE common character scale calibrated from upright pose 1. Crouched and resting poses retain their naturally lower height. Use roomy clear gutters between all cells and generous padding around the ENTIRE body/weapon/cape, with a consistent ground baseline in each row. Genuine RGBA transparency: alpha zero outside each figure and between limbs/props. No floor, shadow, backdrop, haze, vignette, glow, particles, checker pattern, text, labels, frame numbers or grid lines. Keep a coherent animation rather than unrelated character illustrations.
